note: Alberta Parks campground on the northwest shore of Sturgeon Lake near Valleyview. Loops A, B and C sit in boreal forest by Beaver Pond; the Big Horn loop is on the lakeshore about 1.5 km southeast, near the day use and boat launch, with some sites having lake access per the park. Trails link the loops to the day use. --Claude
summary: Read the Young's Point page (updated Sep 9, 2026), advisories, brochure (July 2026) and shop: unserviced C$28 (29), power 15/30 A C$36 (95), 124 sites; season May 14 - Oct 13 (A/B close after Sep 7), reservable May 14 - Oct 12; flush+vault toilets, showers, dump, potable water. Season approx May-Oct -> May 14 - Oct 13. Phone differs; Big Horn waterfront lead; pin OK.
flags: WEBSITE: replace the park root https://www.albertaparks.ca/parks/north/young-s-point-pp/ with the camping page https://www.albertaparks.ca/parks/north/young-s-point-pp/information-facilities/camping/young-s-point/ (200). Shop link (parkId 330141) answered: 'Closed through Wed May 19 2027'.
PHONE: stored 780-538-5350 is the Grande Prairie district line; the page and brochure give 'Information: 780-957-2181' / 'Phone: 780-957-2181'. Recommend 780-957-2181. No Facility Operator line.
SENIORS: the page carries 'This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.'

WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront; read only at the main-loop pin): the operator claims the lake for one loop - page 'Bighorn Loop is nestled along the shore of Sturgeon Lake with some sites having lake access', shop 'the Big Horn loop lakeside'. Imagery of Big Horn (around 55.116,-117.561): the shore row of the loop road runs along the lake with pads/RVs ~25-40 m from the waterline, but a band of tree canopy and a reed/marsh fringe lies between, and the brochure draws the lakeside Alces Trail along that shore. That fails the on-water test (trees + trail between). A view through the trees is not confirmable under canopy. Recommendation: keep not waterfront (going down when unsure); the reviewer may consider lakeview for the Big Horn shore row (Big Horn holds sites 1-35 on the brochure map; which numbers are on the shore row is unread). Loops A-C (the bulk of the sites, at the stored pin) are in forest with no lake in view - not waterfront.

ADVISORIES: Bear Warning (Aug 8, 2025); water shut off from Sep 21, 2026; firewood sales ended Sep 19; seasonal closures (Loops A and B closed after Sep 7, Loop C to Sep 28, Big Horn to Oct 13; after Sep 7 'There is no first-come, first-served camping available'); Trail Warning (Jul 23, 2026).

UNREAD: the shop's full site list - after the first page the shop answered paging requests with a 301 and then hung, so only 9 Loop A sites were read (A-36 31 ft; A-37 to A-44 all 21 ft, under 23 ft - a fit concern for part of Loop A at least). max_rig_ft is not written; Big Horn's 'Near Water' tags are unread.

PIN (55.12730,-117.57980): among loops A-C, at the page's directions point 55.127004,-117.579871 - OK. Big Horn is a separate cluster ~1.5 km SE inside the same park and booking; a split is the reviewer's call.
